correctness.rationale: For real Day–James norm Euclidean on st≥0 and ℓ1 on st<0, normalized unit x ranges over same-sign Euclidean arcs, opposite-sign taxicab facets and four nonsmooth axes. At Euclidean x=(c,s), c²+s²=1, 0<s≤c, its unique BJ partner y=(−s,c)/(s+c), and ||x+y||²=1+1/(s+c)²≥3/2 with equality only c=s. At taxicab x=(.5+u,−.5+u), 0≤u<.5, partner y=(1/√2,1/√2), giving ||x+y||²=3/2+2√2u+2u²≥3/2, equality only u=0. At axis x=(1,0), norming-functional segment fτ=(1,−τ), 0≤τ≤1, y=(τ,1)/√(1+τ²) and ||x+y||²=2+2τ/√(1+τ²)≥2. All symmetry images exhausted; the balanced pair has both symmetric chord norms sqrt(3/2) and is BJ orthogonal in both orders. Thus the complete equality classification and exact infimum follow.
